requirement.requirement_text: 当一通语音通话结束时，语音呼叫平台向系统发送通话分析回调。系统解析该通话的转写文本、通话时长与元数据，并将这些内容交给语言模型进行分析。语言模型返回结构化的分析结果，包括情绪倾向、线索评分（1–10 分）、关键话题、购买信号、客户异议、待办事项以及推荐的下一步动作。这些补充后的数据被同步到 HubSpot，用于更新对应的联系人记录。若线索评分达到设定阈值，系统会在 Slack 中向销售团队发出提醒，并在 HubSpot 中创建一条优先跟进任务。每一次通话都会被记录到 Google Sheets 中用于追踪。

source_spans.text: When a Retell AI voice call ends, the platform sends a call_analyzed webhook to this workflow. It parses the transcript, call duration, and metadata, then sends everything to OpenAI for analysis. The AI returns structured data: sentiment, lead score (1-10), key topics, buying signals, objections, action items, and a recommended next step.

The enriched data is synced to HubSpot, updating the contact record. If the lead score meets your threshold, the workflow alerts your sales team on Slack and creates a priority follow-up task in HubSpot. Every call is logged to Google Sheets for tracking.
